notes: Adds the Calendar Entry Manager: named color groups across months/years, bulk date entry (sticky-year grammar + paste), a clickable month grid, per-entry show-description, and a per-month legend. Rebuilt the calendar template (CalendarGrid / Weekbar / MonthTitle, Sunday-first weekday labels, month title). Timeline overhaul: the DateBar maker now outputs grouped objects named 'Datebar NNN' (fixed height, matching Make Timeline) with the unit stamped; robust unit recognition reads the bar itself (two-bar aware) so Date Snap no longer fails on edited bars; Date Snap is split into Group Move and Line Nudge (with a group-move offer for leaders that can't reach); and Make Entry now prompts for a date with Skip / Confirm / Confirm & Place (drops the entry onto the timeline at its date).
